meta.title: Workspace folders
meta.description: Group existing workspaces into virtual folders in the left sidebar. Folders are a view-only classification: no directory is created or moved on disk. Drag a workspace row onto a folder, use the folder's menu to rename or delete it, or right-click a workspace and pick Move to folder. Folder membership is stored in this browser.
